bio.text: John James, a Republican, has represented Michigan's 10th Congressional District in the U.S. House since January 3, 2023, and is a candidate for Governor of Michigan in 2026.
Before Congress he was president of James Group International and CEO of Renaissance Global Logistics, a Detroit supply-chain company.
He served eight years of active duty as an Army aviation officer, including combat in Operation Iraqi Freedom, and graduated from West Point.
He later earned a master's degree from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan.
